Integration continuation for the existing five M6 workers — #346, 2026-11-03. This follows6607568979 and consumes its returned packets, not a repeat of that extraction. The maintainer asked the coordinator to ensure work continues. Root retains all planning, resolutions, merge order, live integration, acceptance and runtime.

The first round returned: P1's46-row delivery manifest; T1's disjoint79 doctrine corrections with11 genuine competing source paths across targets; T2's26 shared ES paths/89 pair-path intersections; T3's28 unchecked criteria/81 explicit conditions; T5's29 bound distribution deltas and one missing T22 pair. Root has read the reports. Different identities remain inputs, not semantic-conflict verdicts.

Anchors remain coordinator71bee11968b8a2f3b0165004f21c5498a47a6054 and next8ebaf8daad8eaac6331dff6fc048fb4411d7decb. New small metadata-only private outputs; original packets unchanged. CPU8–23. Root will construct and verify integration candidates; workers supply exact bounded input facts.

P1 wN:p3: close only the four delivery-endpoint documentary gaps in your packet. Inspect immutable accepted tips d3aa6a19c5 (#648),7041b0d710 (#649),a1bdd18355 (#659),e8d866507d (#661) for the respective slice's named audit-completion.json and its literal schema/issue/time/evidence-reference fields; name the audit root from the full owning issue/accepted handback. This permits only those named marker bodies and their Git metadata, not referenced historical evidence bodies or old validators. Report marker present/absent and identity exactly. No search of moving branch heads or inferred later tip. Also record the T22 corrected-field supplement from6607912040. The45 historical execution-seed and12 ES seed header absences are not new requirements and need no repair; preserve them as schema-era unknowns. Return the finite candidate-endpoint facts, not an acceptance or choice of integration tip.

T1 wN:p4: deepen only the11 competing source paths in your report (nine T4: device-builds.md,es-code-traps.md,fork-workflow.md,generic-x64-vm-testing.md,instruction-files.md,packaging-and-patches.md,worktrees.md under .claude/rules/, plus AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md; two T38: .claude/skills/code-auditor/references/templates.md and .claude/skills/mini-retro/references/scoped-audit.md). Using your exact literal bases/accepted refs and frozen targets, derive zero-context Git diff hunk ranges and changed-payload hashes for base→accepted and base→target. Classify only disjoint/touching/overlapping base-line intervals and exact equal changed payloads, handling zero-length insertions explicitly. No semantic disposition or automatic-merge claim. Source-hunk reads are now authorized only for these11 files; keep full source bodies and patch text in memory, return numerical ranges/hashes and precise Git commands. No T39 re-review, inherited brief bodies or ledger bodies.

T2 wN:p5: for exactly the26 shared ES paths and89 remediation pair/path intersections in your returned packet, derive zero-context base→accepted hunk ranges and changed-payload hashes using explicit ES base16dbac5211eea7e70db7394372033be2be7df829. All eleven accepted remediation refs stay as returned; T44 remains reference-only. This authorizes new immutable source-hunk reads only for those26 files; do not retain complete source/patch bodies or run catalogue/test parsers. Group equal payloads, disjoint/touching/overlapping base-line intervals and absent-base/addition cases. Preserve the45 French intersections separately from the other44. This is the exact textual composition input for root, not a compatibility verdict or merge. No M7 carried overlay is inferred.

T5 wN:p7: first append a separate supplement for the now-proven T22 reviewed/fixed pair and its29 missing comparisons, reusing your retained29 rows without recomputing them. Then for only the existing nine shared distribution filenames plus any genuinely new T22 intersection, derive zero-context base→accepted hunk ranges/changed-payload hashes at each involved slice's own reviewed-at. Different base identities must be explicit; do not compare coordinates across different base blobs as though aligned. Where bases differ, return the exact base-to-base hunk mapping as a separate fact. Source-hunk reads are authorized only for this finite shared set. No raw/full source export, semantic verdict or merge. Keep original406 comparisons and blank-field failure intact; report the added29 and combined435 count separately.

T3 wN:p6: prepare the missing cross-program distribution boundary, metadata only. Use exact legacy M7 distribution1850362563dc02720f1910faa415ed96580fa7d2 in read-only /workspace/repos/rocknix and its known next base8ebaf8; this is a dated comparison anchor, not a chosen current merge target or permission to touch M7. Compare that anchor's net current-source mode/type/blob/size changes with the finite changed-source keys in T1's /tmp/m6-t1-doctrine-overlap-20261103-nk9mqtnb/report.json and T5's /tmp/m6-integration-source-intersections-t5-20261103/result/net-source-deltas.json. Keep current source apart from historical records using the retained role definitions; no source bodies, M7 worktree/ref writes, status change or runtime. Return exact intersections and ancestry limitations for root's M7/next ownership conversation. Your original closure matrix remains complete; no new criteria verdict.

Read this FULL comment, do only your named task, return one concrete result/early blocker to wN:p2 and stop. No lane waits on another lane's new output. Root consumes the outputs directly for the next integration candidate rather than ordering another audit. Can this be done on the VM? These are bounded immutable textual/metadata comparisons; no runtime behavior is claimed or needed.
